Twelve studios compete for Long Beach's dance students. None has finished the work AI search now rewards.

We audited 12 dance and ballroom studios serving the Long Beach market head to head: site quality, Google's local results, and 6 live checks across ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI. The sites range from 71 to 85. The AI engines name only four of the 12. The field averages 73 (C) on AI readiness, 11 of 12 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 6 of 12 have no llms.txt file. Whichever studio closes that gap first changes the answer for everyone searching this market.

Prepared by SiteTradeIn · Market snapshot generated 18 Oct 2026 · Independent audit — not commissioned by any studio in the field · See the ranked list

About this report

This is a market-wide snapshot, not an audit of a single business. We picked one competitive local market — dance and ballroom instruction in the Long Beach, CA area — and ran the same measurement against every studio that competes for it: an automated site-quality grade across seven categories, where each studio shows up in Google's local results, and 6 live checks asking three AI engines who they'd recommend for two real buyer queries. Every studio named below is graded on identical criteria, on the same day, with no advance notice.

The point isn't to single any one studio out — it's to show what an AI-search-era competitive landscape actually looks like once you measure it instead of guessing at it. If your studio is one of the 12 below, this is where you stand today.

What the field shows

  • Arthur Murray Dance Studio Torrance (85) and Dance Around The Clock OC (85) lead on site quality, and the field runs down to 71. Two scores are shared.
  • No studio earns an A for AI readiness. The field averages 73 (C) on the category that decides whether an AI engine can read, trust and quote a site; the best score in the market is 85.
  • Of the 12 studios, 11 have no FAQ or Q&A structured data, and 6 have no llms.txt file — the two cheapest AI-answer signals available. No studio in the market has both.
  • Four of the 12 are franchise locations (two Arthur Murray and two Fred Astaire); the rest are independent studios.
  • The gap between #1 and #12 is 14 points on identical criteria. Nothing in the scorecard requires a rebuild or a rebrand to close it — just the work.

For a studio not doing this work, that's the default outcome — not a penalty, just the result of nobody in that seat having claimed it yet.

What separates the winners from the rest

  • Off-site proof, not just on-site polish. AI answers draw on what other sites say about a studio, not just on its own pages, so reviews, directory listings and a complete Google profile carry real weight.
  • Being unmistakably “in Long Beach.” Studios that serve Long Beach from nearby towns need pages, profiles and listings that say so in the words people search.
  • A complete, specific site. The strongest sites have no missing H1s or meta descriptions, alt text on their images, and schema that describes what the studio actually is.
  • Content matched to how people actually ask. The broad question and the ballroom question pull from different result sets — a studio needs to answer both.

The monthly SEO / AEO program

Month 2-3Broaden content to match how buyers askContent built around both the specialist and the generic query, and around the city buyers actually search.
OngoingOff-site signal buildingReviews, directory consistency, third-party mentions.
Every monthRe-measure all 3 engines, both queries, and the mapAI answers shift; a competitor closing this gap first changes the answer for everyone else.

Methodology & notes

Field (12 studios): arthurmurraytorrance.com, dancearoundtheclockoc.com, monarchdanceandevents.com, arthurmurraylongbeach.com, andreaelmoredance.com, livingtango.com, fredastaire.com/artesia, demetradance.com, on2ourage.com, levelupdancestudio.com, ycdstudio.com, fredastaire.com/redondo-beach. Chosen from live Google searches on 18 Oct 2026: every adult ballroom, Latin or partner-dance studio with a working website that appeared in Google's local results for Long Beach dance searches. The Los Angeles area is split into six pages: Los Angeles (the city and the Westside), Glendale (with the San Fernando Valley), Pasadena (the San Gabriel Valley), Long Beach (with the South Bay), Anaheim (north Orange County) and Irvine (central and south Orange County). A second Google listing (Long Beach Wedding and Ballroom Dance) points to Arthur Murray Long Beach's website and is counted with it. Living Tango teaches out of The Monarch Ballroom's building and is rated separately. Left out: Long Beach Dance Center (no website of its own, though ChatGPT names it), private wedding and salsa instructors (DANCEBLEND, Dance with David, Josie Neglia, CD Event Choreography), DIVA M Ballroom and La Casa de la Rumba (no website of their own), Queerchata (classes at rotating venues), youth and recital studios (The Dance Company, Studio M Dance Academy, Kick It Up, Gravity, Elevation, Center Stage, Tutu School, Epicenter, Fusion, Marquee, Dance 1), South Bay Dance Center (now an event-rental venue), and Romance and Dance (its site lists no classes).

Site audit: the same SiteTradeIn engine run for every studio on 18 Oct 2026, up to six pages per site, seven categories. Franchise locations that live on a national website (Fred Astaire) share that site's robots.txt, llms.txt, sitemap and templates.

AI visibility: 6 live checks — ChatGPT, Gemini and Google AI, each asked “What are the best dance studios in Long Beach, CA?” and “What are the best ballroom dance studios in Long Beach, CA?” with a request for a top-five numbered list. Rankings are taken from each engine's own list; presence was confirmed by reading the raw response text, and every franchise mention was matched to its location. Each question was asked in a fresh session of each engine's web app (ChatGPT and Gemini in temporary, unpersonalized chats, Google's AI Mode), not through a developer API.

Google: local (Places) and first-page organic results captured in a live browser session on 18 Oct 2026 for “ballroom dance lessons long beach ca”; “dance lessons long beach ca”; “salsa lessons long beach ca”; “wedding dance lessons long beach ca”; “ballroom dance lessons torrance ca”, plus the organic searches “best dance studios in long beach ca” and “ballroom dance studio long beach”. Each query named the city; results vary by searcher location and over time.

Independence. This report is a market-wide measurement, not commissioned by or customized for any single studio named in it.

Limits. AI answers and search results vary between runs and over time; these are a point-in-time sample, not a fixed ranking.
